speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. You mentioned gait and limb ataxia; to begin my evaluation, could you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms and if they are getting worse over time?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I'm sorry to hear you're feeling this way. You mentioned the clumsiness is especially on the right side; are these symptoms constant, or do they come and go? Also, have you noticed any weakness, numbness, or difficulty speaking alongside your gait issues?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy in a patient with Crohn's disease.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain (with and without contrast).
